items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC7 covered: rejected/decision kinds mirrored client+server, server resolves positionally and returns words only when confirmed, fail-closed notice in every other state, audit gets structured form fields, fence/inherited record pointers read unknown, learning label chips + live editor reading + warning, countersigned fixture written by the real writer and hash-pinned, e2e on the org page.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Record read never throws: open/fstat/read errors become unreadable with a fixed detail; route validates JSON, pointer and quote before IO; client treats HTTP errors and unknown answers as not checked.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Fixed file names (never from the pointer), O_NOFOLLOW + fstat + realPathGuard, 5 MB cap, words only on confirmed (route test asserts no echo), POST + no-store keeps the quote out of URLs and caches, write guard (same-site, JSON) applies, plain text rendering only.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Server: 15 reader/route tests incl. leadwright's own cases, writer-to-reader with the real reject writer, file states, quote bounds; fixture test against the real countersign; client: 7 label cases from leadwright, 4 view tests, 10 component tests incl. every fail-closed state and the live editor; e2e on the isolated stack.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One request per proposal that cites a record (others none); file size checked via fstat before reading; regexes are anchored with disjoint parts; label parse is a few regexes per keystroke, no fetch from the editor.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New server module 220 lines, client components split (OperatorWordsEvidence, LearningLabelView) to keep DecisionEntryDetail small; every new file under 300 lines; mirrors keep the verbatim marker section.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producers decisions-rejected writer and countersign writer -> files -> new reader: round-trip probes via toRejectedBlock and handleCountersignRequest (fixture); leadwright renderEntry Evidence bullet -> parseEvidence: rejected/decision pointers with quote parsed in view tests and e2e; route JSON -> client fetcher checked for unknown statuses.
